scripts.install:mac: npm run build:mac && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='dist/Krathorn Launcher-darwin-arm64/Krathorn Launcher.app';const dst='/Applications/Krathorn Launcher.app';if(fs.existsSync(dst))fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Installed to',dst)"
scripts.install:mac-intel: npm run build:mac-intel && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='dist/Krathorn Launcher-darwin-x64/Krathorn Launcher.app';const dst='/Applications/Krathorn Launcher.app';if(fs.existsSync(dst))fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Installed to',dst)"
